cues: After the final bell, students gathered beneath the covered walkway while rain tapped against the courtyard windows.
The greenhouse stayed humid overnight, encouraging tiny droplets to gather along the broad leaves of young ferns.
At dawn, fishing boats crossed the quiet bay as pink light spread across the eastern horizon.
The museum's west gallery closed early because a leak had appeared above the painted ceiling.
A flock of starlings shifted direction together, briefly forming dark ribbons against the sunset.
